description: In crates/transit/src/import/rnews.rs, parse_rnews_batch() calls decompress_cunbatch() with ? and then unreachable!() because decompress_cunbatch always returns Err. The comment even says 'this is unreachable'. The idiomatic fix is to change the cunbatch arm to a single expression: return decompress_cunbatch(&input[CUNBATCH_MARKER.len()..]).map(|_| unreachable!()); — or more cleanly, restructure to: return Err(decompress_cunbatch(...).unwrap_err()); But the cleanest is: the arm can just be: decompress_cunbatch(&input[CUNBATCH_MARKER.len()..])? followed by unreachable!() — which is what it does. Minor style: consider returning the error directly via a helper that returns Result<!, RnewsError> once never_type stabilizes, or just leave a comment. Low priority.
title: parse_rnews_batch cunbatch arm uses unreachable!() instead of idiomatic never type
